candidates.statement: 1. (2.1.1) Unless otherwise specified in a monograph, an appropriate sample weight is chosen, typically 1-2 grams, to result in a level of residue sufficient to be accurately measurable by weight (typically 1 milligram). If not specified in the monograph, the appropriate sample weight should be justified, and the sample weight and the acceptance criteria should be specified in the application dossier.
